tasks.task: On the fit ranker, click the Pet-friendly chip, click the Budget chip, and type 130 into the nightly budget box.
tasks.expected: All seven listings stay on screen — nothing gets hidden — with the line reading 3 top fits of 7: Dockside Nook · Old Port, Garden Studio · Midtown, and Willow Walk-up · Riverside rank on top, each scored Fit 3/5, the $95 tie putting Dockside before Garden alphabetically, while Sunset Flat · Old Port sits last at Fit 0/5.

tasks.task: On the fit ranker, click only the Waterfront chip, then click it again to turn it off.
tasks.expected: With the chip on, all seven listings remain visible, the line reads 3 top fits of 7, and Dockside Nook, Harbor Loft, and Sunset Flat rise to the top each scored Fit 2/2, Harbor before Sunset on the $145 price tie; turning the chip off drops the scores, returns the plain 7 stays line, and leaves the grid in price low-to-high order.

tasks.task: On the fit ranker, with no chips picked, type 100 into the nightly budget box.
tasks.expected: All seven listings stay visible; Dockside Nook · Old Port and Garden Studio · Midtown move to the top each scored Fit 1/1, the line reads 2 top fits of 7, and the rest follow in price low-to-high order with Maple Suite before Willow Walk-up on the $120 tie.

tasks.task: Open the fit ranker page and look at its overall styling and how listings are labeled.
